svg.title: Sheet 6 - Event cards 1-9, 60 x 88 mm (A4)
svg.desc: Nine "shit happens" cards, same size as the Activity cards so the two decks handle alike. Draw two every week, after the week is laid out. Sheet 7 carries cards 10-18.

g.text: Not information - it's about being seen.
Nobody explains the reasoning to you.
An Align or a Demo also clears it.
A feature that passed a Demo is safe.
Everybody called it a small addition.
Last week was the wrong thing.
Nobody wanted to be the one to ask.
Nobody's fault, and it costs a week.
